decisions.reason: Restricting the outreach tab to responding leads does not change the existing rule that a lead is entered into HubSpot when ready to schedule.
The source decision concerns which Airbnb leads appear in the outreach tab, not the task-local CRM structure deliverable.
The product-listing spreadsheet tracks commerce products and is unrelated to the Airbnb outreach-tab lead criterion.
The requirement to include deliverable links is unaffected by which leads are retained in the outreach tab.
The source changes post-outreach lead tracking, not the method used to select Airbnb hosts for outreach.
The inclusion criterion for the outreach tab does not resolve or change the outreach message template, recipient, or delivery method.
CJ product selection and import are unrelated to tracking responding Airbnb leads.
The source decision concerns the Airbnb outreach tab and does not change the Google Content Bank deliverable.
The Pinterest task deliverable is unrelated to the Airbnb lead spreadsheet inclusion criterion.
Shopify product publication remains unchanged by the rule governing which Airbnb leads appear in the outreach tab.
